deploy-bot: [ALERT] promotion failed for release/1.12.0
deploy-bot: action=promote_artifact target=prod tag=release-1.12.0 status=FAILED reason=stamp_id_mismatch code=409

alice.k: saw this when running the promotion pipeline, build artifacts look ok locally tho. anyone know what "stamp_id" is here?

benj: short version — our cache stamp is a small metadata token we write when uploading build artifacts to the shared cache. parallel matrix jobs can race and one job overwrites the stamp before the promoter reads it, so promoter sees unexpected stamp and refuses to promote.

priya.m: repro log snippet from job-7:
```
Uploading wheel: redwood_inference-1.12.0-py3-none.whl
write_stamp: stmp-3f2a
promoter: read_stamp: stmp-41b3
promoter: artifact digest matches but stamp mismatch -> aborting promotion
HTTP 409: conflict
```

samir.o: that matches a race I've seen in canary a while back. fix was either locking writes or using deterministic stamp generation + compare-and-swap. both are nontrivial in the short term.

alice.k: we have a change window at 15:30 today. do we roll back the queued release or pin and rerun a single sequential build?

benj: suggestion: block automatic promotion, manually validate the artifact uploaded by job-7 and push a signed artifact into the registry with a new tag, then cut the release from that tag. avoids full rollback. downside: manual step and potential missed changelog automation.

priya.m: +1 for manual promotion if we can verify integrity quickly. I can run integrity checks and smoke tests in staging, should be ~20-25m.

ci-runner: queued jobs: promote-job (waiting), release-notes-gen (waiting), canary-deploy (waiting). auto-retry disabled for promote-job because of stamp mismatch policy.

alice.k: @priya.m can you take lead? @samir.o can you draft a short rollback play if manual promotion fails? we'll decide in 25m.

samir.o: will do. rollback play: revert release branch -> redeploy previous tag (release-1.11.3), invalidate queued promotions, open postmortem ticket with timeline + fix proposal (lock or CAS).

benj: also adding a quick guard: change promoter to accept promotion if artifact digest matches and stamp age < 2m, as a temporary heuristic (with audit log). low risk and unblocks. I can prepare a small PR to promote service with that guard, but it needs review.

alice.k: timeline: 15:10 decision. if @priya.m verifies and we can manual promote by 15:25 we go ahead. otherwise rollback at 15:30. pls update thread with status. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

priya.m: starting integrity checks now, will report in ~10m.

deploy-bot: [INFO] locked release-queue for release/1.12.0 per manual hold by alice.k

priya.m: smoke tests passed on staging build from job-7, checksum and model loads ok. manual signed-push scheduled and paperwork for release notes updated.

benj: manual signed push done -> tag=release-1.12.0-manual-1
promote API returned 200. canary deploy kicked off.

alice.k: thanks all — proceeding with canary. We'll follow up with a small postmortem and a short note in release notes about the manual step. closing hold. :white_check_mark:
